directed_contracts: Seven-task slugify preserves archive hierarchy, duplicate-ID dependency target sets and readiness; second pass is idempotent.
Nested archived parent reopens beside an existing active container.
Open or malformed actual descendants block parent closing without changing the tree, in active and archived stores.

independent_review.earlier_rounds: Reviewed all substantive repairs; 16 one-shot syscall failure points covered closing, reopening and slugify rollback. Follow-up review verified each resulting fix and affected behavior.

scope: All mutations ran on disposable synthetic or copied stores. Live task contents and private fixtures are not committed. Installed CLI unchanged. Execution tested only macOS arm64.
limits: Multi-ID commands and slugify commit successful earlier items before a later item fails.
True active/archive destination conflicts are refused, not merged.
Cleanup can fail after a successful reopen and is reported explicitly.
Directory locks serialize cooperating Dots writers, not direct filesystem editors.
Static symlink refusal does not establish protection against hostile symlink races.
Ordinary injected failures do not establish power-loss or process-kill durability, or recovery when rollback syscalls themselves keep failing.
Linux syscall paths were not executed in this validation.
